moon_a3_peak_near_cabeus_b.method: Horizon traced from a 400 m LOLA terrain model out to 90 km in 72 directions; Sun over a lunar day at 12 seasonal points, Earth over its libration range; peak temperature from radiative balance (albedo 0.15, emissivity 0.95) on the 2 km slope.
